tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam pa'i chos sgrogs byed pa'i sngon rjes kyi bsam brjod rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dge mtshan dpal mgur dung dkar g.yas 'khyil las// bgrang yas chos phung mi zad dbyangs ldir bas// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i nyon mongs rim bcom nas// yang dag lam ston zas gtsang sras kyis skyongs// dad gsum gyis dben tha mal kun spyod khas// chos bsgrags byin rlabs dpag yas 'byin dka' ba// dug can gdug pas gnas par sgron ma nyid// gsal yang 'od cher 'byin bzod min pa mtshon// gzhan brtse byang chub sems kyis rgyud sbyangs nas// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor la gnas chos spyod dge /spyad pa'i bsod nams phung po dpag yas nyid// 'thob pa lung gis dngos bstan 'dir nges bya// de'ang rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin po che gang du bsgrags pa'i phyogs der/ stegs kyi khar dar ras gtsang mas bkab par me tog gi sel mas bkrams te/ nye bar spyod pa ci 'byor ba bsham/ rang gi mdun du klog khri'i steng du glegs bam zhal phye ste bzhugs su gsol ba rnams nyer bsdogs bya'o// dngos gzhi dge ba'i las thams cad la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum tshang ba'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos pas/ dang po ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum gyi tshogs bzhugs pa la/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ bka' lung dri ma med pa bsgrag par bgyi'o snyam pas/ ngag tu/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed/ rang gi rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// zhes sogs nas/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis bzang spyod smon lam dbu nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya/ sems can thams cad la dmigs nas/

'gro rnams bde ba bde rgyur bcas la spyod// sdug bsngal kun 'byung bcas dang bral gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bder gnas nye ring dag /chags sdang med pa'i btang snyoms gnas gyur cig /ces tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags dang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom pa ni/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags so// gnyis pa ni/ 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin gyis// yod med mtha' bral stong pa'i ngang nyid las// mi 'jigs bzhi ldan gdong lnga'i dbang po brgyad// khengs pas rab bteg bkod legs rin chen khri// skyon bral chu skyes 'dab rgyas lte ba la// dkar gsal kun phan rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor steng*// bdag nyid skad cig gsal rdzogs bcom ldan 'das// nyi ma'i rgyud 'khrungs ston mchog gser gyi mdog /bzod pa dam pas brgyan pa'i zhal ras la// nyin byed 'char ka'i mdzes pas sgrun du med// 'jam mnyen phyag gnyis chos 'chad mnyam gzhag dang*// zhabs zung mi phyed rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// thun mtshams dmar 'od gsal pa'i mdzes sdug stong*// gcig tu bsdus 'dra'i chos gos gsum mdzes sku// mtshan bzang dpe byad snang bas 'jig rten 'gengs// zhal 'dzum dkyus ring spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// 'phags dang so skye sde brgyad 'dus pa'i 'khor// thams cad dga' ba'i 'dzum bcas mdun bdar ba// ston zla rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor mi ltung phreng*// grangs med kun nas bskor bzhin lham mer bzhugs// bdag gi smin mtshams la sogs sku'i cha las// 'od zer 'phros pas stong gsum 'jig rten khams// khyab par snang byas 'od des reg pa'i mod// sems can dmyal ba'i byol song gshin rje yi// 'jig rten rgyun chad mi khom gnas brgyad bral// bde 'gro lha mi rnams dang skal mnyam gyur// thams cad dam chos mnyan phyir lhags nas ni// dad dga' rgyas pa'i sems kyis 'khod par gyur// bdag nyid ston mchog dgyes pa'i zhal sgo nas// 'phrul gyi ljags brkyangs 'od zer grangs med spros// 'od kyi rtser bzhugs rgyal ba bye ba phrag

/grangs med 'khor dbus chos 'khor bskor bar gsal// chos rnams thams cad rmi lam sgyu 'drar snang*// snang tsam ngo bo skye 'gag gnas pa med// med bzhin rang snang ma 'gags cir yang 'char// 'char sgo rang rig brjod bral ngang nyid nas// lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad// grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji tsam pa// thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan no// zhes brjod la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sogs gsung rab gdon bya gang yin pa de myur bul 'tsham par chos kyi sgra lhang nge ba dang bcas pas 'don dgos te/ chos nyan pa dang*/ klog pa dang*/ kha ston byed pa rnams la ngag nas brjod pa'i sgra dag cing gsal bar gdon dgos kyi/ mig 'grims dang mgo bsgril khong klog tsam gyis mi chog ste/ chos kyi sgra gzugs can gzugs med kun gyis thos pa las phan yon 'byung dgos pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ de ltar chos bsgrags zin pa'am dgongs mor 'jog mtshams byed pa na/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang*/ bzod par gsol ba ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab gdod nas dpyad gsum gyis// rnam dag thog mtha' bar dge'i phrin las kyis// 'gro ba'i sgrib gsum drungs 'byin bdag nyid la// nor 'khrul nyes pas sgrib 'gyur mi srid mod// de tshul ma rtogs sgo gsum sgrib pa dang*// lhan cig sangs rgyas bka' lung bsgrags pa la// lhag chad nor 'khrul ma dag gyur pa rnams// kun gzigs spyan sngar mthol bshags bzod par gsol// 'khor gsum mi dmigs par brtul nas dge ba yongs su bsngo ba ni/ ston mchog chos 'khor bskor ba'i 'dra 'bag nyid// lam byed chos bsgrags chos nyan 'khor tshogs bcas// 'khor gsum sgyu 'phrul mi dmigs chu yi rlabs// chu gter klong du sim ltar mnyam par gzhag /theg gsum dam chos rin chen bsgrags pa las// bsam yas dge ba bdag gis gang thob pa// de yis 'gro kun theg gsum dam pa'i chos// rin chen dri ma med pa'i snod gyur cig

/bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs brtan zhing*// bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng khyab pa dang*// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang dpal 'byor rgyas// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa nyid gyur cig /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa sogs/ bsngo ba smon lam dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ rnam gsal byas so rab dwangs me long ngos// bltas pas rang zhal gnas tshul khyad par rnams// tshul 'dis chos sgrogs byed pa'i sngon rjes kyi// bsam brjod 'os pa'i bya ba ci dang ci// gsung rab dgongs 'grel bcas pa'i dga' tshal nas// thar pa'i cha mthun legs btus me tog rnams// rjod byed snyan dngags srad bur brgyus pa'i phreng*// rgyal gsung ji snyed mdzes pa'i rgyan du spud// dge bas nyi ma'i gnyen gyi lung rtogs chos// de 'dzin bgyi ba bshad sgrub phrin las rnams// lhan cig rgyas pa'i byin rlabs sde bzhi'i dpal// mi zad 'gro ba kun gyis spyod gyur cig /ces dam pa'i chos sgrogs byed pa'i sngon rjes kyi bsam brjod rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos kyi 'dri klog lhur len pa bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor/ bka'i gleng gzhi dang dgongs 'grel 'ga'i bzhed pa dang mthun par ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sder bod pas sbyar ba sarba satwāṃ hi taṃ bha wan+tu// // ༄༅// sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i gsol 'debs 'dod don 'grub pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ru tā rā yai/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mtshar sdug gi /'jo sgeg dran pa'i glog gi rtse dga' rer// 'gro tshogs sdug bsngal las sgrol rje btsun ma// bdag gzhan 'jigs pa gang lags gnas las skyobs// phyogs kyi go chas mu stegs pham byas pa'i// lan du me btang gtsug lag khang bsregs tshe// khyod la gsol btab me dpung char chus bsad// de bzhin bdag sogs me yis 'jigs las skyobs// klu gdug char phab grong khyer 'jig nye'i dus// 'chi med seng ges gsol btab chu klung tshogs// bzhugs gnas g.yas skor bdun byas rgya mtshor song*// de bzhin phyi nang 'byung chu'i 'jigs las skyobs// slob dpon lha seng stag gzigs rgyal po yis// btson bskyur lcags sgrog gang bcings me tog gyur// ngo mtshar slob dpon rgyal po'i bla mar bkur// de bzhin rgyal po'i chad pa'i 'jigs las skyobs// saṃ gha mi tra chom rkun tshogs kyis bcings// durga'i lha mo mchod phyir gsod par gzas// gsol btab lha rten zhig rgyus chom rkun bros// de bzhin dgra jag chom rkun 'jigs las skyobs// legs smra grags pa bkrad phyir gar log pas// glang chen dmag bkye sgrol ma'i sngags btab chus// gtor tsam kha los ma thub gzhan du bros// de bzhin dgra dpung glang chen 'jigs las skyobs// sangs rgyas 'bangs nyid stag mo mi zan gyis// gtses par sgrol ma'i sngags bzlas chus gtor bas// sems can mi 'tshe dam bcas lha yul skyes// de bzhin gcan gzan gdug pa'i 'jigs las skyobs// dug sbrul sbram chen mi mang glang chen zos// dkon mchog gsum 'bangs gsol btab sngags bzlas thun// gtor bas gaṅgā'i lam rgyud rgya mtshor bros// de bzhin klu gdon rigs kyi 'jigs las skyobs// srin po'i gdon gyis grong khyer mi kun shi

/ro langs ye shes lha yis sngags bzlas btul// bdud rtsi'i char phab shi ba phal cher bsos// de bzhin bdag gzhan gdon gsum 'jigs las skyobs// 'jigs brgyad kyis mtshon phyi nang 'byung tshogs khams// rnam par 'khrugs pa'i bro rims ji snyed dang*// gnam sa bar gyi gdon gnod dus min 'chi'i// 'jigs kun las sgrol thugs rje'i phyag ring rkyongs// bsod nams khang chen ring 'tsho'i ka ring tshugs// chos srid bde 'byor sum rtsen dpal gyis gtams// gtsug lag kun rig rnam dpyod legs bris bu// lung rtogs bdud rtsir dgyes dgur rtsen par mdzod// phyi nang rig par dpyod pa'i lhab lhubs rtser// rgyud don nor bu'i tog mdzes rgyal mtshan gang*// blun rmongs mgo bo 'gems pa'i dogs bral yang*// dpyod ldan kun dga'i rgyan du gzugs par mdzod// ces sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i gzugs bkod 'dod gsol du bcas pa 'di'ang*/ sde dbon ye shes rgya mtshos bskul ngor/ lha ris pa rnams rang bzor gang dran bris pa'i cal rgyug rjes 'brang tsam las/ khungs thub 'di yin ma mchis par brten/ mkhas pa'i gsung rab kyi sngon byung lo rgyus yid ches las drangs pa'i gzugs bkod zhal byang gsol gdab bcas pa 'di'ang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
